proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F _ _ _ _ T hT
  let R := LinearMap.range (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)
  haveI : ProperSpace R := FiniteDimensional.proper 𝕜 R
  refine ⟨(↑) '' Metric.closedBall (0 : R) ‖T‖, (isCompact_closedBall _ _).image continuous_subtype_val, ?_⟩
  refine Filter.mem_of_superset (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds (0 : E) one_pos) ?_
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨⟨T x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
  have hx' : ‖x‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa using hx
  rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
  show ‖T x‖ ≤ ‖T‖
  calc ‖T x‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖x‖ := T.le_opNorm x
    _ ≤ ‖T‖ * 1 := by gcongr
    _ = ‖T‖ := mul_one _
